'''Murcott Island''' (Japanese: '''マーコット島''' ''Murcott Island'') is one of the [[Orange Islands]]. It featured in the {{aniseries|OS}} episode ''[[EP097|Tracey Gets Bugged]]''. It is famous for being home to many rare {{type|Bug}} Pokémon, leading some to compare it to a [[Safari Zone]]. On the island a {{TP|Tracey|Scyther}} was attacked and badly injured by its own swarm. Because of this, {{Tracey}} {{pkmn2|caught}} it. The majority of Murcott Island is covered in dense forest, and a lake is also present. A fairly large town with tall buildings exists some distance away from the beachfront.

==Places of interest==
===Pokémon Center===
[[File:Murcott Pokémon Center.png|thumb|220px|Murcott Pokémon Center]]
{{main|Pokémon Center}}
The Pokémon Center on Murcott Island is located in the town area. The building is white with columns and an orange domed roof. The Center almost looks like a giant Town Hall with a "P" on its front. Inside, it is run by [[Nurse Joy]] and {{TP|Nurse Joy|Chansey}}.
{{left clear}}
